newsitem.title: USA: TurboChef cools in New Year.
newsitem.headline: TurboChef cools in New Year.

text.p: TurboChef Inc stock fell on Thursday after a strong rise in recent weeks, traders said.
Stock in the maker of commercial ovens fell 3-3/8, or 15.25 percent, to 18-3/4 in late-afternoon trade. The drop was among the largest on the Nasdaq and volume was a heavy 257,400 shares.
Traders said the stock was not being affected by corporate news but was easing off after rising from about eight points at the start of December.
The rise was helped by news on Dec 17 that Southland Corp had placed an order with the Dallas company for ovens to be used in its 7-Eleven stores.
"There really is no news," a trader said. "It's had a good rise since the start of December, and now it's being pulled down at the start of the year."
